notes.title: Looking For Alpha/Beta Testers!
notes.content:
Hey!

This is Caff here, the dev behind Jetpackin' Heat++, and I'm making this announcement because I'm looking for a couple more beta testers! I have a small crew already, but many of which are people I know, so I want to get in touch with anyone who may be interested in the game as an anonymous tester of sorts.
Main reason that I want a couple anon testers is for the freshest of perspectives, to get the thoughts and feedback of people who aren't as acquainted with my work on the game or that I don't have much (if any) contact with before, because getting a nice and juicy unbiased opinion helps me in the long run.

If anyone is interested, either friend me here on Steam, ask me in the discussions, or hit me up on Discord (Caff#4200). There aren't any major qualifications for the position, only that you can make sure to be available whenever I put up a new test build so I can plod scheduling properly.

First devlog should be coming soon as well!

- Caff
